proposals.rationale: Add an explicit companion exception qualifying baseline prohibition C0000, providing that takeoff with inoperative instruments or equipment is excepted from the requirements of paragraph (a) when conducted in accordance with paragraph (d).
proposals.quote: Except as provided in paragraph (d) of this section,

scope_quotes: (a) Except as provided in paragraph (d) of this section, no person may take off an aircraft with inoperative instruments or equipment installed unless the following conditions are met:
fields.scope_text: Takeoff of an aircraft with inoperative instruments or equipment installed under paragraph (a)
fields.logic_text: Except as provided in paragraph (d) of this section
fields.summary: The prohibition against taking off an aircraft with inoperative instruments or equipment installed without meeting conditions (a)(1) through (a)(5) does not apply to operations conducted as provided in paragraph (d) of 14 CFR 91.213.

proposals.rationale: Add an explicit companion exception qualifying baseline prohibition C0008, establishing that instruments and equipment required by an airworthiness directive may be included in a Minimum Equipment List if the airworthiness directive provides otherwise.
proposals.quote: unless the airworthiness directive provides otherwise.

scope_quotes: (2) Instruments and equipment required by an airworthiness directive to be in operable condition unless the airworthiness directive provides otherwise.
fields.scope_text: Instruments and equipment required by an airworthiness directive to be in operable condition considered for inclusion in a Minimum Equipment List
context_quotes: (b) The following instruments and equipment may not be included in a Minimum Equipment List:
fields.logic_text: unless the airworthiness directive provides otherwise
fields.summary: Instruments and equipment required by an airworthiness directive to be in operable condition are excepted from the prohibition against inclusion in a Minimum Equipment List if the airworthiness directive provides otherwise.

proposals.rationale: Add an explicit companion exception qualifying baseline permission C0010, excluding operations conducted in accordance with paragraph (a) or (c) from taking off under the paragraph (d) relief without an approved Minimum Equipment List.
proposals.quote: Except for operations conducted in accordance with paragraph (a) or (c) of this section,

scope_quotes: (d) Except for operations conducted in accordance with paragraph (a) or (c) of this section, a person may takeoff an aircraft in operations conducted under this part with inoperative instruments and equipment without an approved Minimum Equipment List provided—
fields.scope_text: Operations conducted in accordance with paragraph (a) or (c) of this section
fields.logic_text: Except for operations conducted in accordance with paragraph (a) or (c) of this section
fields.summary: The authorization to take off an aircraft with inoperative instruments and equipment without an approved Minimum Equipment List under paragraph (d) does not apply to operations conducted in accordance with paragraph (a) or paragraph (c) of 14 CFR 91.213.

observations.quote: Notwithstanding any other provision of this section,
observations.rationale: The non-obstante lead-in to paragraph (e) is already represented in permission claim C0013 and does not operate as an independent exception excusing duties.

observations.quote: If deactivation of the inoperative instrument or equipment involves maintenance, it must be accomplished and recorded in accordance with part 43 of this chapter;
observations.rationale: The requirement governing maintenance during deactivation under paragraph (d)(3)(ii) is already represented as a separate claim in C0011.
